{{Quote|...Topping tonight's news&mdash;Rebel terrorists have been reported operating in the Ringali Shell. The Rebel agitators have attacked civilian targets near Brentaal, Essesles, and Rhinnal.|Ashii Nermani reports the news|<ref name="Orbit" />}}
'''Ashii Nermani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial HoloVision]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. One of the most popular Imperial HoloVision newscasters, Nermani reported that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on the attacks by a [[Solar Terrors|group]] of Alliance [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Ringali Shell]], and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|In other news, Imperial Center Security has announced the sudden and tragic death of Imperial Advisor Coh Veshiv in a space accident.|Nermani, during her news report|<ref name="Orbit" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Ashii Nermani worked for [[Imperial HoloVision]], a news agency that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occasionally used for [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] purposes.<ref name="Orbit" /> As of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> at the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Empire was fighting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she was one of the most popular newscasters. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Orbit" /> Nermani was the first to break the story that [[Venslas Beeli]] was a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] working for the Alliance<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|371|Nermani, Ashii}}</ref> in a report on the attacks that a [[Solar Terrors|group]] of Alliance [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Beeli, were carrying out on innocent civilians in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Ringali Shell]]; the group, a captured pirate band known as the [[Solar Terrors]], was actually forced by the Imperials to commit the crimes, as the Imperials wanted to draw out the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', an Alliance [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. In that same report, Nermani covered up the fact that [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]] had been [[Capture of Coh Veshiv|captured]] by the same ''Far Orbit'', by informing the public that the [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] had [[Death/Legends|died]] when his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] hit a wayward [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="Orbit" />

==Personality and traits==
Nermani had hair of a lighter [[Color/Legends|shade]], and wore earrings at the time of her report on the Alliance terrorists, as well as a loose garment with a brooch on it that she wore on her upper body.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ashii Nermani first appeared in the adventure scenario ''[[The Rival]]'', published in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. ''The Far Orbit Project'' was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. Nermani's report is intercepted by the players, which leads them to go and track down the pirates that are sullying their reputation and that of the Alliance.
